scope: Local equivalence and timing for rendering only the affected project during reconciliation planning

motivation.observation: An application-only change promoted by the Deploy workflow re-rendered and re-applied the whole cluster.
motivation.source: reconciliation report artifacts reconciliation-35559992436-1 and reconciliation-35730117830-1

change.behaviour: Planning renders only the affected project subtree when every changed path sits inside exactly one platform/projects/<project>/ tree.
change.fallback: Any other change set keeps the full flux-system recursive render.

environment.note: Renders used --kustomization-file with the in-repo platform-projects Kustomization and --dry-run so the comparison is reproducible without cluster access.

equivalence.method: Documents labelled kustomize.toolkit.fluxcd.io/name=platform-projects for the project were extracted from the full recursive render and compared byte-for-byte after YAML canonicalisation against the scoped render.

negative_control.comparison: llunde scoped render compared against the y project expectation

selection_tests: two projects keep the full render
cluster, component, charts and parent paths keep the full render
empty change set keeps the full render
internal/ tooling changes force the full scope
limitations: The production stage numbers come from two bounded runs and are not percentiles.
Local render time is dominated by a warm kustomize cache; production time is dominated by cluster API round trips, so the measured local ratio understates the production effect.
Only the plan stage is scoped by this change; the kubernetes apply stage still reconciles the whole cluster graph and remains the next candidate.

The scoped render still resolves the live platform-projects Kustomization from the cluster, so the exact production command shape differs from the offline equivalence command by the --kustomization-file and --dry-run flags.
